q: A lot of information in this report ______ useful.
Azmal, together with his friends, _________ to the market every day.
One of my best _____ getting married today.
Choose the correct sentence:
o: To swim every morning keeps him healthy.
To read books are always enjoyable.
That she sings well surprise everyone.
Reading novels are my favourite pastime.
e: Subject যদি infinitive (to + verb), gerund, noun clause বা কোনো phrase হয়, তবে তা একবচন ধরা হয় এবং verb singular বসে। To swim every morning একটি infinitive phrase, তাই keeps শুদ্ধ। অন্যগুলোতে ভুল আছে: To read books-এর পরে is, Reading novels-এর পরে is, আর That she sings well-এর পরে surprises বসা উচিত ছিল।

q: _______ was fifty-nine.

The number of errors are surprising.

q: The United States ___ a large country.
e:
দেশের নামে s থাকলেও দেশ একটি একক সত্তা। তাই এমন নাম বহুবচন নয়, একবচন হিসেবে গণ্য হয় এবং Verb হয় is। ঠিক এই কারণেই Mathematics, Physics-এর মতো বিষয়ের নামের সঙ্গেও singular verb বসে।
মনে রাখুন:
The United States is, The Philippines is
Physics is, Politics is
একই নিয়মে 'The Netherlands is a small country.'

q: Which of the following sentences is correct?
o: Neither the workers nor their leader were present.
Neither the worker nor their leaders was present.
Neither the workers nor their leader were presence.

q: The number of books in the library ________ constantly expanding.
There ___ a large number of _____ playing in the field.
Choose the correct sentence-
o: Many a students were present at the conference yesterday.
Many a students was present at the conference yesterday.
Many a student is present at the conference yesterday.
Many a student was present at the conference yesterday.
e: Many a/an-এর পরে singular countable noun এবং singular verb বসে। গঠন: Many a/an + singular noun + singular verb। এখানে Many a-এর পরে student singular, আর অতীত কাল বলে verb was হবে। Many a students বা were-সহ বাক্যগুলোতে plural ব্যবহার হওয়ায় ভুল, আর is present ... yesterday কালের সঙ্গে মেলে না।

q: (a) Neither the teacher (b) nor the students (c) was aware of the schedule change . (d) No error.
e: Neither ... nor দিয়ে দুটি subject যুক্ত হলে verb শেষ subject-এর সঙ্গে মেলে। এখানে শেষ subject the students বহুবচন, তাই verb হবে were, was নয়। ভুল c অংশে। শুদ্ধ বাক্য: Neither the teacher nor the students were aware of the schedule change। দুটি subject-ই একবচন হলে verb একবচন হয়, যেমন Neither he nor his brother is present। আবার বচন আলাদা হলে বহুবচন subject-টি verb-এর কাছে রাখা ভালো।

q: Find the part that has an error: The athlete’s movements was restrained fluid and seemingly effortless to the viewer.
e: বাক্যের subject 'movements' বহুবচন, তাই verb-ও বহুবচন হবে: 'were'। 'was' singular subject-এর সঙ্গে বসে, ফলে এখানে ভুল। বাক্যের অর্থ 'খেলোয়াড়ের নড়াচড়াগুলো সংযত, তরল ও দেখে মনে হতো অনায়াস'। সঠিক বাক্য: The athlete's movements were restrained, fluid and seemingly effortless to the viewer. সূত্র: subject-এর শেষ শব্দ s-যুক্ত plural হলে (possessive athlete's ছাড়া) verb-ও plural হয়।
